title.en: An Act Repealing Section Ten of Republic Act Numbered Fifty-Six

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_344_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Section ten of Republic Act Numbered Fifty-six is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 14, 1949
